
```{devoirs_choices likelihood_framework_11_two_choices}
- A framework in which hypotheses compete and likelihood serves as each hypothesis's data-based score.:
    correct: true
    feedback: Correct.
- A way to rank or compare hypotheses according to the likelihood of the observed evidence under each.:
    correct: true
    feedback: Correct.
- The probability distribution that summarizes knowledge after data are processed.:
    correct: false
    feedback: That is the posterior distribution in the Bayesian framework.
- A method that compares models without using any observations.:

- A framework that assigns each hypothesis a probability of being true based only on prior belief.:
    correct: false
```
